summary: Jill Keister shares her family's stressful house-selling experience as a framework for exploring Psalm 143, a psalm of lament. She demonstrates how David's knowledge of God's character enabled him to pray boldly even in deep distress, and challenges the congregation to meditate on God's past faithfulness so they can trust Him in present trials and become more aware of His presence in daily life.
key_points: Psalm 143 is a lament where David cries out boldly because he knows God's faithful character
Remembering and meditating on God's past works shapes our prayer life and gives us hope
Physical posture affects spiritual position - extending our hands to God in trust and surrender
We must become more aware of God's presence working all around us
Knowing God's character changes how we live and pray
big_idea: Knowing God's character through meditating on His past faithfulness enables us to boldly pray and trust Him in present distress while becoming more aware of His presence in our daily lives.
title: Sunday @ Canvas Community Church
